RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of bias; panels typically reflect existing departmental leadership and HR staffing. For a director-level municipal position, executive competencies—such as political acumen, stakeholder engagement, and public consultation—often outweigh technical credentials or years of service. 

Raising gender without documented procedural breaches or discriminatory remarks will appear speculative, damage your professional reputation within municipal government networks, and undermine legitimate inquiries. Furthermore, a two-week response time is standard for municipal bureaucracy. 

Instead, follow up courteously to request constructive feedback on your interview performance. Frame the request around professional growth to understand which specific competencies were prioritized.
